entries.source_quote: On activation, he dashes in a direction.
Aatrox unleashes his true form for 10 seconds, gaining bonus movement speed that decays by 10% of the current bonus every 0.25 seconds. Bonus MS is 60/80/100% at ranks 1/2/3.
Spirit Rush: Ahri dashes forward and fires essence bolts, dealing damage to up to 3 nearby enemies. Can be cast 2 more times within 10 seconds before going on cooldown.
Active: Ahri gains 40% bonus movement speed that decays over 2 seconds and conjures three flames which orbit her clockwise for up to 2.5 seconds.
Recast: Akali dashes towards the marked target or smoke section. Against enemies she deals magic damage upon arrival. Shuriken Flip cannot be recast if the target is not visible or is untargetable.

For 2 seconds, she gains 30% / 40% / 50% / 60% (based on level) bonus movement speed while moving away from the center of the ring. When Akali exits the ring, for 2 seconds, she regains the bonus movement speed while facing nearby enemy champions.

Active: Akali dashes 750 units in the direction of the target enemy champion, dealing magic damage to enemies she passes through. If this hits an enemy, she flips over them to continue the dash up to the normal range but for at least another 150 units.
Active: Akali restores 100 energy over 0.4 seconds and gains bonus movement speed that decays over 2 seconds. Bonus Movement Speed: 30/35/40/45/50%.

First Cast: Akshan fires a hook in the target direction that embeds in the first terrain hit. Second Cast: Akshan swings around the terrain. Third Cast: Akshan ends the swing by jumping to the target location.
While Going Rogue and moving towards nearby Scoundrels, Akshan gains 80 / 90 / 100 / 110 / 120 bonus movement speed and bonus mana regeneration equal to 12% of his missing mana.
Headbutt: Alistar dashes to a targeted enemy within 650 units, dealing magic damage and knocking them back. Alistar's body travels to the target location - this is self-displacement to the target.

Entering an attack or movement command while casting an ability will cause Ambessa to dash a short distance once the ability is cast, granting her next attack bonus range, damage, and attack speed, and refunding energy.
Ambessa blinks to the farthest enemy champion in a line of her choosing and suppresses them upon her arrival.
Bandage Toss: Amumu throws a bandage in a target direction, dealing magic damage and stunning the first enemy hit. If the bandage hits an enemy, Amumu dashes to them. Stores 2 charges.
Active: Annie grants herself or the target allied champion and Tibbers a shield for 3 seconds and 20% : 50% (based on level) bonus movement speed that decays over 1.5 seconds.

Aphelios enters an onslaught for 1.75 seconds, gaining 25% (+ 10% per 100 AP) bonus movement speed and automatically performing up to 6 (+ 2 per 100% bonus attack speed) attacks over the duration against the nearest visible enemy, prioritizing enemy champions.

Active: Aurelion Sol dashes in the target direction and resets Breath of Light's cooldown. During flight, he has unobstructed vision and Breath of Light has no cooldown and maximum channel duration and its flat damage is increased, but Astral Flight's dash speed is reduced by 50% during its channel.
Active: Aurora blasts energy in a line in the target direction and recoils 250 units in the opposite direction.
Active: Aurora leaps in the target direction with displacement immunity over 0.4 seconds. She then gains Realm Hopper for 3.5 seconds and unleashes a shockwave from 425 units in front of her.

Upon completing the dash, she becomes invisible for a duration and gains Realm Hopper for 4 seconds. Realm Hopper: Aurora becomes ghosted and gains bonus movement speed for the duration. Bonus Movement Speed: 20/25/30/35/40%.

Active: Azir grants himself a shield for 1.5 seconds and dashes to the Sand Soldier closest to the cursor, dealing magic damage to enemies within his path. A summoned Sand Soldier is required to cast this ability.

Bard opens a one-way portal through Terrain for seconds. Any champion can enter the portal by moving onto it. Taking Magical Journey is considered a dash; Bard and allies travel through the corridor at 33% increased speed.
Bel'Veth dashes in a chosen direction and damages all enemies she passes through. Each direction has an independent cooldown.

Active: Bel'Veth dashes to the target Void Coral to consume it over the cast time, slowing nearby enemies by 25% : 96% (based on seconds elapsed) for the duration. A nearby Void Coral is required to cast this ability.

Overdrive: Blitzcrank supercharges himself to gain 70/75/80/85/90% bonus movement speed (max rank 90%) that decays to 10% over the first 2.9 seconds, plus 30% attack speed, for 4 seconds total. When the effect ends, Blitzcrank is briefly slowed.
While his shield is raised, Braum also gains 10% bonus movement speed and ghosting. Shield lasts up to 4 seconds at max rank.
Braum leaps to a target allied champion or minion, granting the target Armor and Magic Resistance for a few seconds on arrival. Requires an allied champion or minion target within 650 units.

Active: Briar leaps to the target unit. If the target is an enemy, she deals magic damage, applies on-hit effects, triggers on-attack effects, stuns them for 0.85 seconds, and reduces their armor and magic resistance for 5 seconds.

Hematomania: Briar gains all effects of Blood Frenzy as well as bonus armor and bonus magic resistance equal to 20% AD, life steal, and additional bonus movement speed. [Additional Bonus Movement Speed: 10/20/30%, stacks on top of Blood Frenzy's 60% for 70/80/90% total MS while Hematomania is active]

Blood Frenzy: Briar breaks free from her pillory, causing her to become forced to basic attack the nearest enemy. She reveals the target and gains ghosting, bonus attack speed and bonus movement speed... Blood Frenzy: bonus movement speed 24/33/42/51/60%.
Caitlyn fires a heavy net to slow her target. The recoil knocks Caitlyn back.
Hookshot: Camille fires a hookshot that grapples to terrain, then fires a second hookshot that launches her toward an enemy champion, knocking them briefly airborne.
Active: Camille becomes untargetable and leaps with displacement immunity towards the target enemy champion over 0.5 seconds, revealing them for the duration and disrupting their ongoing channels.
If Noxious Blast hits an enemy champion, Cassiopeia gains bonus movement speed that decays over 3 seconds. Bonus Movement Speed: 30/35/40/45/50%.
Corki flies over and scorches a path, burning it for a duration. He flies up to 1800 units forward in a line, dropping a trail of fire.
Darius leaps to an enemy champion and strikes a lethal blow, dealing true damage. Resets on kill at rank 3.
Lunar Rush: Diana dashes to the target enemy. If the target has the Moonlight debuff, it is consumed, dealing bonus damage; otherwise Lunar Rush has an increased cooldown.
Active: Draven enters an adrenaline rush, gaining bonus attack speed for 3 seconds as well as decaying bonus movement speed and ghosting for 1.5 seconds. (max rank 70%)

Active: Dr. Mundo injects himself with chemicals to become enhanced for 10 seconds, gaining increased base health, bonus movement speed, and bonus health regeneration. (Bonus Movement Speed: 15% / 25% / 35%)

Active: Ekko dashes in the target direction, then empowers his next basic attack within 3 seconds to have a 0.25-second cast time, gain 300 bonus range, cause him to blink within 125 range of the target, and deal bonus magic damage.
Innate - Stolen Time: Triggering Resonance against a champion grants Ekko 50% / 60% / 70% / 80% (based on level) bonus movement speed for 2 / 2.5 / 3 (based on level) seconds.

Active: Ekko enters stasis at the start of the cast time, and afterwards heals himself and dashes to his afterimage's location at the time of cast over 0.5 seconds. Upon arrival, the stasis ends and he creates an explosion that deals magic damage to nearby enemies. Ekko is immune to all displacements during Chronobreak.
Spider Form: Elise and her Spiderlings ascend into the air and then descend upon target enemy. Elise will always attempt to position behind her target if she descends within Rappel's max range (825).

Spider Form - Venomous Bite: Active: Elise pounces at the target enemy with her fangs. Elise will not dash if the target is within basic attack range. Can cross sufficiently thin terrain. Grounded flag: true.
Active: Evelynn whips the target enemy with her lashers, dealing magic damage and applying on-hit effects. Evelynn also gains bonus movement speed for 2 seconds.

Active: Evelynn reveals her true form, becoming untargetable at the start of the cast time and then unleashing her lashers in a cone in the target direction, dealing magic damage to enemies struck within. After 0.5 seconds, she blinks 700 units in the opposite direction and becomes targetable again.
Active: Ezreal blinks from his current location to up to 475 units towards the target location, then fires a homing bolt towards the nearest enemy.
Active: Fiddlesticks channels for 1.5 seconds, then blinks to the target location upon completion with a murder of crows flying wildly around it for 5 seconds.

Duelist's Dance: When Fiora triggers a Vital, she gains 20% / 30% / 40% (based on Duelist's Dance rank, max rank 3 = 40%) bonus movement speed that decays over 1.85 seconds. At max P rank the bonus is 40%; Grand Challenge (R) extends this to 50% when R is active.
Fiora lunges in a direction and stabs the closest enemy, ward, or structure, dealing physical damage. Dash range increased to 400.
Fiora reveals all four Vitals on a champion and gains Move Speed while near them (Duelist's Dance bonus enhanced to 50% at R max rank, decaying 1.85s on Vital proc).

Fizz dashes to the target location (range 25-400) while becoming untargetable, balancing on his trident for 0.75 seconds. He can recast to dash again (range 75-300) ending the untargetable effect early.
Fizz dashes a fixed distance in the direction of the target enemy, dealing magic damage plus physical damage if within 200 units upon arrival.
Justice Punch: Galio charges then dashes forward, knocking up the first enemy champion hit.

Hero's Entrance: Galio designates an ally's location as his landing spot then leaps through the air globally, crashing down at the target ally's location and dealing damage and crowd control on landing.
If Gangplank successfully hits a target with Trial by Fire, he gains 15% : 30% (based on level) bonus movement speed for 2 seconds.
Active: Garen cleanses himself of all slows and gains 35% bonus movement speed for a duration. (duration scales 1.4/1.95/2.5/3.05/3.6 seconds by rank)

Active: Gnar leaps to the target location, then gains bonus attack speed for 6 seconds. If Gnar lands on a unit he will bounce 500 units further in the same direction. Landing on an enemy deals them physical damage and slows them by 80% for 0.5 seconds. (Crunch mega form: Active: Gnar leaps to the target location and deals physical damage to nearby enemies upon impact.)

The third stack against a target consumes them all to deal bonus magic damage, capped at 300 against monsters, and grant Gnar 20% / 40% / 60% / 80% (based on GNAR!'s rank) bonus movement speed that decays over 3 seconds.
Gragas charges to a location and collides with the first enemy unit he comes across, dealing damage to all nearby enemy units and stunning them.
Quickdraw: Graves dashes in a targeted direction, reloading one shell. Auto attacks on non-champions reduce this cooldown.
Active: Gwen dashes to the target location, then empowers her basic attacks within the next 4 seconds to deal bonus magic damage on-hit and gain bonus attack speed and 75 bonus attack range.
Active: Hecarim becomes ghosted and gains 25% : 65% (based on time active) bonus total movement speed for 4 seconds.
Active: Hecarim dashes with displacement immunity to the target location and summons 5 spectral riders in an arrow formation that charge alongside him in the target direction.
Gain 20% bonus Move Speed while near allied towers and turrets deployed by Heimerdinger (within 300 range).

Active - WQ (Fleeting Current): Hwei forms a current of water in the target direction, creating a path for a duration that grants him and allied champions bonus movement speed and ghosting for 0.5 seconds, with the bonus refreshing every 0.125 seconds while they remain in the area.

Active: Irelia dashes 100 units through the target enemy's location, and upon collision or dash completion, she deals physical damage, applies on-hit effects, and heals herself. Bladesurge's current cooldown is reduced to 0.2 seconds upon collision of targets marked as Unsteady, and is reset if the target dies to or during Bladesurge's dash.

Ivern and allied champions can select the target rooted by Rootcaller to dash to their location, stopping at their attack range. Recast: Ivern dashes to the rooted target. Ivern and his allies are not able to dash to the target unless they are within 1200 units.
Passive: Janna is ghosted and gains bonus movement speed. (Bonus Movement Speed: 6/7/8/9/10%)
If the lance connects with a deployed Demacian Standard, Jarvan IV dashes to its location, knocking up nearby enemies around him and along his path. Dragon Strike cast range is 770 units.
Jarvan IV heroically leaps into battle at a target with such force that he terraforms the surrounding area to create an arena around them.
Leap Strike: Jax leaps toward a target location, dealing damage if it is an enemy. Can leap to allied wards and champions.

Active (Cannon form - Acceleration Gate): Jayce and all allied champions can move through it to gain bonus movement speed that decays over 3 seconds. The buff is continuously refreshed while inside the gate.
Innate: Whenever Jayce switches between either Hammer Stance or Cannon Stance, he gains ghosting and 40 bonus movement speed for 0.75 seconds.

Active: Jayce leaps to the target enemy's location over 0.5 seconds. Upon arrival, he smashes his hammer to the ground to deal physical damage to all enemies within an area and slow them for 2 seconds.
Additionally, critical strikes against enemies grant Jhin 14% (+ 0.4% per 1% bonus attack speed) bonus movement speed for 2 seconds.
Jinx receives massively increased Move Speed (175% bonus, decaying over 6 seconds) whenever she helps kill or destroy an enemy champion, epic jungle monster, or structure.
Supercharge: Kai'Sa charges up briefly, gaining bonus movement speed, then discharges her suit to gain a burst of attack speed. While charging Kai'Sa gains 40% bonus movement speed.
Killer Instinct: Kai'Sa channels briefly then dashes to a location near a Void-Plasma-marked enemy champion, gaining a shield on arrival.

Innate: Whenever Kalista inputs a movement command during her basic attack windup or the cast time of Pierce, she will dash a short distance in the direction of the inputted location. At a 90 degree angle, the maximum dash range is 240 / 263 / 280 / 300 (based on Boots Tier) units.
Active: Karma grants a shield to herself or the target allied champion for 2.5 seconds as well as 40% bonus movement speed for 2 seconds.
Kassadin teleports to a nearby location dealing damage to nearby enemy units. Multiple Riftwalks in a short period of time cost additional Mana but also deal additional damage.
Shunpo: Katarina blinks to a target unit or Dagger, dealing damage if the target is an enemy. If she blinks to a Dagger, she picks it up, applying On-Hit effects.
At max stacks (5), she becomes Exalted, gaining 10% bonus movement speed. Zeal stacks last 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks.
Active: Kayle and the target allied champion are healed and gain bonus movement speed for 2 seconds. Bonus Movement Speed: 24/28/32/36/40%.

Active: Kayn gains 40% bonus total movement speed, ghosting and the ability to ignore terrain collision for a duration. Shadow Assassin Bonus: upon entering terrain, the bonus total movement speed is increased to 70% for the remaining duration.
Active: Kayn dashes in the target direction, dealing physical damage to enemies he passes through. He then swings his scythe, dealing the same damage to nearby enemies.

Active: Kayn vanishes and dashes to a marked enemy champion over 0.25 seconds, attaching himself to them at the end of the dash. Recast: Kayn deals physical damage to the target and dashes out from their body in the target direction.
Kennen transforms into lightning, becoming Ghosted and gaining 100% bonus Move Speed while dealing magic damage to enemies he passes through.
Kha'Zix leaps to an area, dealing physical damage upon landing. Evolved Wings increases range by 200 and resets the cooldown on champion kill or assist.
Kha'Zix becomes invisible for 1.25 seconds, during which he gains 40% bonus movement speed. Evolved Adaptive Cloaking adds a second charge.
Dance of Arrows: Kindred leaps in the target direction and shoots up to three arrows at nearby enemies, briefly gaining attack speed.

Active: Skaarl dashes in the target direction, though not through terrain. Upon hitting an enemy champion or large monster, Skaarl dashes a fixed 200 units through them. Jousting can be recast after 0.5 seconds of the first dash ending while the target is marked. Recast: Skaarl consumes the mark to dash through the marked target, able to dash through terrain.

Kled gains 70 : 155 (based on level) bonus movement speed while facing and after attacking nearby visible enemy champions. Kled will retain the bonus movement speed buff for 1.5 seconds while facing an enemy champion even if that champion is no longer visible. (Dismounted form only)
Active: Kled sprays a cone of five pellets in the target direction while recoiling 300 units in the opposite direction, dealing physical damage to enemies hit. (Only while dismounted)
While charging, the duo gain bonus movement speed... up to 950 total movement speed over 3 seconds. Kled & Skaarl will dash toward the first visible enemy champion in range of the charge.
Innate: Upon taking fatal damage, Kog'Maw enters a zombie state for 4 seconds, becoming ghosted and gaining 10% bonus movement speed that increases up to 50% over the duration.
K'Sante dashes to the target location (range 250, or 550 toward an ally through terrain), granting himself a shield for 2 seconds.
K'Sante blinks 175 units behind the target's location after knocking them back (or 100 units behind terrain if terrain is within 350 units in the cast direction).

K'Sante prepares to dash in the target direction, charging for 0.4 to 1 second, gaining displacement immunity. On recast, dashes in the cast direction dealing physical damage to enemies passed through.
Recast: LeBlanc blinks to Distortion's return pad, regardless of range.
Resonating Strike: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by Sonic Wave, dealing physical damage based on the target's missing Health.
Safeguard: Lee Sin rushes to target ally, shielding himself from damage. If the ally is a champion, they are also shielded.
If she hits at least one enemy champion, she will dash 225 units behind the last one struck within 3000 range and root them for 0.5 seconds.

Passive: Whenever Lillia's abilities hit at least one enemy, she generates a stack of Prance for 6.5 seconds, stacking up to 4 times. Prance: For each stack, Lillia gains bonus movement speed. Maximum Bonus Movement Speed: 12/16/20/24/28%.
Active: Lillia dashes to 150 units in front of the target location over 0.759 seconds, though not through terrain, and deals magic damage in an area around the target spot.

Active: Lissandra sends a claw of ice in the target direction that deals magic damage to enemies it passes through, decelerating over 1.25 seconds. Recast: Lissandra consumes the claw and blinks to its current location.
Lucian quickly dashes a short distance. The cooldown is reduced whenever Lucian hits enemies with Lightslinger attacks.
When cast on herself, Lulu grants 25% (+ 5% per 100 AP) bonus movement speed for 3 / 3.25 / 3.5 / 3.75 / 4 seconds.

Active: Malphite sends a shard to the target enemy that deals magic damage and slows them for 3 seconds. Malphite also gains bonus movement speed equal to the raw amount the target lost from the slow for the duration. (Slow: 20% / 25% / 30% / 35% / 40%)
Active: Malphite dashes with displacement immunity to the target location. Upon arrival, he deals magic damage to nearby enemies and knocks them up for 1.5 seconds.
Hitting at least one enemy champion grants Maokai bonus movement speed decaying over 2 seconds. [Bonus Movement Speed: 40/50/60%]
Active: Maokai dashes to the target enemy while being untargetable. Upon arrival, he deals magic damage and roots them for a duration.
Master Yi becomes Untargetable and teleports to rapidly strike enemies near his target, dealing physical damage to all enemies hit after multiple hits.
Master Yi gains ghosting, bonus attack speed, bonus movement speed (35/45/55% at ranks 1/2/3), slow immunity, and cripple immunity for 7 seconds.

FIRST-PASS ERROR: 'Void Slick' does not exist on Mel in patch 16.11.1. Mel E is Solar Snare (projectile root - no self-movement). This entry should be removed; Mel W (Rebuttal) carries the self-mobility (30% decaying MS in the additional_entries above).
Active: Mel forms a protective barrier around herself for 0.75 seconds, becoming invulnerable to non-turret damage and gaining 30% decaying bonus movement speed.
Active: Milio envelops himself or the target allied champion in protective flames, granting the target a shield and bonus movement speed for 2.5 seconds. Bonus Movement Speed: 12/14/16/18/20%.

Passive: Miss Fortune gains bonus movement speed after 4 seconds without taking non-persistent damage, ramping to a higher tier after 3 additional seconds (60/70/80/90/100 flat MS at max tier, max rank). Active: instantly grants the max-tier MS bonus (100 flat at rank 5). Duration lasts until she takes direct damage.
Wukong dashes to a targeted enemy (625 unit cast range) and sends clones to nearby targets, also granting temporary attack speed.
Wukong gains 20% bonus Move Speed and spins his staff, dealing damage and knocking up nearby enemies for the duration.
Wukong dashes in a direction while becoming invisible and leaving behind a clone (300 unit dash at 1200 dash speed).

Darkness Rise: Mordekaiser gains 3% / 6% / 9% (based on level) bonus movement speed and deals magic damage every second to nearby enemies. Active while Darkness Rise is active (requires 3 stacks from hitting champions or large monsters with attacks or abilities).
Active: Naafiri dashes in the target direction and deals physical damage to enemies she passes through. Upon arrival, she explodes in a flurry of blades to deal physical damage to nearby enemies.
Active: Naafiri and her Packmates channel for 0.75 seconds to single out the target enemy champion... Upon completion of the channel, they dash to the target.

Active: Naafiri goes on the hunt for the next 5 seconds, becoming untargetable for the first 1 second... While on the hunt, Naafiri gains 20% AD bonus attack damage and grants herself and all Packmates bonus movement speed. (Bonus Movement Speed: 20% / 22.5% / 25% / 27.5% / 30%)

Innate: Nami's abilities grant 100 (+ 25% AP) bonus movement speed to allied champions hit, decaying over 1.5 seconds. (Nami can self-cast W to trigger on herself; ~30% of base MS at rank 1, doubled from Tidal Wave)
Nautilus hurls his anchor forward. If it hits an enemy, Nautilus drags himself and the target together. If the anchor hits terrain, Nautilus will drag himself towards it.
Shapesplitter: Passive: Every third attack deals bonus magic damage. Active: Neeko briefly becomes invisible, sending a clone speeding forward. Neeko gains bonus movement speed.

Innate - Prowl: While in brush, Nidalee gains ghosting and 10% bonus movement speed, increased to 30% while facing a visible enemy champion within 1400 range. The bonuses persist for 2 seconds after leaving brush. Innate - Hunt: Hitting enemies with Javelin Toss or Bushwhack grants 10% bonus movement speed for 4 seconds, increased to 30% while facing a Hunted target.

Active: Nidalee leaps a fixed distance in the target direction. Upon arrival, she deals magic damage to nearby enemies. Hunted Bonus: Nidalee can perform Pounce from an increased range on a Hunted enemy closest to the cursor.
Active: Nilah dashes a fixed distance in the direction of the target unit, dealing physical damage to enemies she passes through. Nilah periodically stocks a Slipstream charge, up to a maximum of 2.

Active: Nilah envelops herself in mist for 2.25 seconds, during which she becomes ghosted, gains 15% / 17.5% / 20% / 22.5% / 25% bonus movement speed, reduces all incoming magic damage taken by 25%, and dodges all non-turret basic attacks.
While on the Dusk Trail, Nocturne is Ghosted and gains 15/20/25/30/35% increased Movement Speed and bonus Attack Damage.
Nocturne can recast Paranoia to launch himself at an enemy champion dealing physical damage. Dash range: 2500/3250/4000 units (per rank).

Call of the Freljord: Gain 20% bonus attack speed and 10% bonus movement speed. Triggered when Nunu and Willump deal damage against an enemy champion, large monster or structure, lasting 4 seconds (extending on successive triggers).

Willump creates a snowball that grows in size and speed. Nunu and Willump move together with the snowball; movement speed is reduced 50% initially then gains +14 per 0.25 seconds up to a cap (approx. 595 + 100% bonus MS at max charge). Slow-immune and ghosted.

Ragnarok: Olaf temporarily becomes immune to crowd control. For the first second of Ragnarok, Olaf gains 20/45/70% bonus movement speed (max rank 70%) while facing visible enemy champions within 2000 units, plus armor penetration for the full duration.
Active: Ornn charges in the target direction, dealing physical damage to enemies he passes through and stopping upon colliding with terrain. Charge range 450 units.

Recast: Ornn dashes in the target direction, though not through terrain. If he collides with the elemental, he sends it stampeding in the same direction. (recast dash speed 1600; requires active elemental)
Ornn stomps forward Unstoppably while breathing fire, dealing magic damage over several seconds. Enemies hit by the final bout of flame become Brittle for a duration.
Mortal Will: After recasting, Pantheon gains 5 : 30 (based on level) (+ 2.5% bonus health) bonus armor and bonus magic resistance for 4 seconds as well as 60% bonus movement speed for 1.5 seconds.

Active: Pantheon channels for 2 seconds, then leaps high into the air, vanishing and becoming immune to crowd control until he reappears... Upon completion of the channel, Pantheon reappears at the target location and gains maximum stacks of Mortal Will.
Active: Pantheon leaps to the front of the target enemy's location. If the target is within 800 units upon arrival, he deals physical damage and stuns them for 1 second.
Poppy tackles an enemy, dealing physical damage and carrying them forward. If Poppy tackles them into terrain, the enemy is Stunned.
Active: Poppy gains 40% bonus movement speed and creates an aura around herself for 2 seconds, causing all enemies who attempt to dash into or within it to be dealt magic damage and knocked up.
Phantom Undertow: Pyke dashes to a location, leaving behind a drowned phantom. After a delay, the phantom returns to Pyke, stunning all enemies it passes through.
If Death from Below hits an enemy champion or at least one is killed inside the X by the execution or an ally, Pyke will blink to the center of the X.

Active: Pyke submerges into water for 5 seconds, entering camouflage and gaining 45% (+ 2% per 1 Lethality) bonus movement speed that decays over the duration. Attacking or casting abilities ends Ghostwater Dive immediately.
Active: Qiyana dashes a fixed distance in the direction of the target enemy. If they are in range upon arrival, she deals physical damage.
Active: Qiyana dashes up to 300 units towards the target location to gather the Element of the nearest Brush, River or Terrain she targeted. A target Element is required to cast this ability.

Active: Quinn dashes to the target enemy, marking them as Vulnerable, dealing physical damage, knocking them back a very short distance over 0.5 seconds, and slowing them by 50% decaying over 1.5 seconds. She then leaps back 525 units away from them.

Active: Quinn channels for 2 seconds, signaling Valor to pair up. Upon completion, he picks her up and they unite, increasing her total movement speed by 70% / 100% / 130% (based on rank), granting her ghosting, and allowing her to cast Skystrike. Lasts until Skystrike is cast or she takes damage from an enemy champion.
Rakan dashes to an allied champion (700 unit range), granting them a shield. Can be recast once within a short window to dash again.
Rakan gains 75% bonus Move Speed for 4 seconds, becoming Ghosted and Charming the first enemy champion he touches.
Rakan dashes up to 600 units to a target location, then spirals into the air Knocking Up enemies for 1 second and dealing magic damage.

Active: Rammus channels for up to 6 seconds to roll into a ball, gaining 25% : 39.17% (based on level) bonus total movement speed per second over the duration, up to a maximum of 150% : 235% (based on level). Powerball can be recast after 1 second within the duration, and does so automatically afterwards or upon casting Defensive Ball Curl.
Rammus hops into the air and slams down at a target area. Range is 800 or 150% of current movement speed (whichever is greater), scaling with Powerball speed.
Tunnel (Burrowed - Tunnel): Rek'Sai digs an entrance to a tunnel at her current location. She can blink between tunnel entrances when nearby.

Void Rush: Rek'Sai marks a visible enemy champion with a Void Rush mark. She can then cast Void Rush again to dash at great speed toward the marked target, emerging from beneath to deal massive damage.

Burrow: Rek'Sai burrows into the ground, becoming ghosted and gaining 15/20/25/30/35 flat bonus movement speed while burrowed (max rank 35), as well as Tremor Sense. Her abilities are replaced by burrowed versions.

Active: Rell powers up herself and the target allied champion for 3 seconds, both gaining 10% bonus movement speed which increases to 25% while moving within 1200 units of the empowered ally or an enemy.

Active: Rell thrusts her lance in the target direction, lunging forward 100 units and destroying the damage-mitigating shields of all enemies hit before dealing them magic damage and stunning them for 0.65 seconds.
Active: Rell becomes Mounted, gaining 30% bonus movement speed decaying over 2 seconds... (Ferromancy: Mount Up - only while Dismounted)

Active: Renata infuses herself or the target allied champion with a chemtech formula for 5 seconds, granting the target bonus attack speed and bonus movement speed while they are facing nearby visible enemy champions or minions, with both of the bonuses increasing in effectiveness by 0% : 100% (based on seconds elapsed). (max rank MS ~40% at full ramp)

Active: Renekton dashes a fixed distance in the target direction, dealing physical damage to enemies he passes through. If Renekton hits an enemy, he can cast Dice within the next 4 seconds. Dice - Active: Renekton dashes a fixed distance in the target direction, dealing the same physical damage to enemies he passes through.
While in Brush, Rengar leaps at his target with his basic attack. Rengar will also leap Attack when Camouflaged.
Rengar prowls for a duration (12/16/20s at ranks 1/2/3), gaining bonus movement speed (40/50/60% at ranks 1/2/3). After a 2-second delay, he also becomes camouflaged.
Valor: Riven's battle instincts allow her to dash forward and create a temporary shield.
Broken Wings: Riven strikes out with her blade for 3 sequential attacks, dashing a short distance with each attack.
Rumble also gains bonus movement speed for 1 to 1.32 seconds. Bonus Movement Speed: 10/15/20/25/30%. Danger Zone Bonus: shield strength and bonus movement speed are increased in effectiveness by 50%.

Active: Ryze unleashes a runic blast in the target direction that deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and consumes all Rune stacks. If Ryze consumed 2 stacks, he gains bonus movement speed for 2 seconds.

Active: Ryze channels for 2 seconds to open a portal beneath him, marking the target location as its destination (cast range 3000 units at all ranks). Upon completion, Ryze and allied units within will blink to the location and become rooted, disarmed, silenced and untargetable for 0.75 seconds.
Samira dashes through an enemy (including structures) slashing enemies she passes through for 600 range, dealing magic damage and gaining attack speed. Cooldown refreshes on champion kill.

Daredevil Impulse: When attacking immobilized enemies not within her attack range, Samira dashes to them from up to 800-1000 units (based on level, maximum at level 18 = 1000 units). Conditional on target being immobilized.
Sejuani charges forward, knocking enemies into the air. She stops upon hitting an enemy champion. Range: 650.

Active: Seraphine grants a shield to herself and nearby allied champions for 2.5 seconds. For the same duration, she also gains 20% (+ 2% per 100 AP) decaying bonus movement speed and grants allies 8% (+ 0.8% per 100 AP) bonus movement speed.
For 1.5 seconds, Sett also gains 30% bonus movement speed while facing visible enemy champions within 2000 units.

Active: Sett suppresses and reveals the target enemy champion while dashing with displacement immunity to their location and attaching them to himself upon arrival. He leaps another 600 units in the same direction to slam the target into the ground, creating a massive shockwave and quickly sliding forward 250 units beyond the impact. (cast range 400; total self-displacement up to ~1250)
Active: Shaco becomes invisible for a duration, and after a 0.125-second delay, he blinks to the target location.
Active: Shaco vanishes for 0.5 seconds and blinks in the target direction while creating a clone of himself that is summoned in the opposite direction.
Shen dashes in a direction, taunting enemies in his path.
After channeling for a short time, Shen teleports to his ally's location with his Spirit Blade.
Dragon's Descent: Shyvana transforms into a dragon and takes flight toward a target location, breathing fire along her path that damages enemies in her wake.
Burnout: Shyvana deals continuous damage to nearby enemies and gains bonus movement speed for 3 seconds, which decreases over the duration.

Innate: Whenever Singed moves near a champion, he gains a stack of Noxious Slipstream for 2 seconds, stacking up to 25 times. Noxious Slipstream: For each stack, Singed gains 25% bonus movement speed, up to a maximum of 625% at 25 stacks.

Active: Singed empowers himself for 25 seconds with ability power, bonus armor, bonus magic resistance, bonus movement speed, bonus health regeneration, and bonus mana regeneration. Bonus Stats: 25/60/95 (flat value shared across all stat types; movement speed component is approximately +95 flat at rank 3).
Active: Sion gains 67% bonus movement speed that decays over 2.376 seconds. Once at least one ability has been learned, Death Surge can be cast using any ability key.

Active: Sion becomes immune to crowd control and ghosted and, after a brief delay, charges forward in the direction of the cursor for up to 8 seconds. The charge ramps up Sion's movement speed at the time of cast by 40 movement speed every 0.1 seconds, up to 950 total movement speed.
Spell Shield: Creates a magical barrier that blocks a single enemy ability. If a spell is blocked, Sivir receives health and a burst of movement speed.

Fleet of Foot: Sivir's basic attacks and ability hits on enemy champions grant her 55-75 flat bonus movement speed (level-scaling; 75 at level 18) decaying over 1.5 seconds. Expressed as ~20% of base MS at max level. Conditional on hitting an enemy champion.
On The Hunt: Sivir leads her nearby allies, granting them a surge of 40/50/60% Move Speed for 4 seconds. Duration refreshes on takedowns.

Skarner charges forward and passes through terrain. If he collides with a champion or large monster, he slams them into the next wall. Charge lasts up to 2.75 seconds with progressive speed increase, passes terrain, effective travel range up to ~1700 units.
If Skarner hits at least one champion with Impale, he gains 40% bonus movement speed for 1.5 seconds while dragging suppressed champions.
Flap, Flap, Flap: Smolder flaps his wings and dashes in the target direction, briefly taking to the air.

Flap, Flap, Flap: Smolder takes flight for 1.25 seconds, gaining 75% bonus movement speed, unobstructed vision, and the ability to ignore terrain collision. While in flight, he automatically fires bolts at the nearest visible enemy.
Active: Sona gains 20% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus movement speed for 7 seconds. If she takes damage during this time, the duration ends prematurely once or if 3 seconds have elapsed.
Innate: Soraka gains 90% bonus movement speed while facing nearby allied champions that are below 40% of their maximum health.

If this hits at least one enemy champion, star dust returns to Soraka, granting her Rejuvenation for 2.5 seconds. Rejuvenation: Heal every 0.5 seconds and gain bonus movement speed that decays over the duration. (max rank 30% decaying)

Abduct (E recast): Sylas whips out his chains in the target direction. Upon hitting the first enemy, Sylas dashes to their location and knocks them up for 0.5 seconds upon arrival. Chain range ~950, conditional on the chain hitting a target.
Active: Sylas dashes to the front of the target enemy's location then strikes them to deal magic damage. If this damages a champion, Sylas is also healed.
If the target is an ally, Tahm Kench will also gain 40% bonus movement speed for 3 seconds and is unable to cast movement spells besides Abyssal Dive while an ally is inside of his belly.

Active: Tahm Kench channels for 1.35 seconds as he dives into the waters, then blinks to the target location after a 0.15-second delay and remains unable to act for 0.65 seconds after the channel completes.
Innate: While near terrain, Taliyah gains 10% / 15% / 25% / 40% (based on level) bonus movement speed, which builds up over 1 second while in range for at least 0.4 seconds.

Recast: Upon completing the channel, Taliyah surfs on the wall as it emerges. After 0.75 seconds, she may input a movement command to jump off the wall to the target location, and automatically does so upon being immobilized or silenced or reaching maximum range.
Talon vaults over the nearest terrain or structure (725 unit range). Each terrain piece has a lengthy cooldown before reuse (160-60 seconds depending on rank).

Noxian Diplomacy: If the target is outside melee range, Talon dashes to them (estimated dash speed 1400) and stabs. Within melee range, the dash does not fire and Talon performs an enhanced auto instead. Conditional on target being outside melee range.
Shadow Assault: Talon becomes Invisible while gaining 40% bonus Move Speed for up to 2.5 seconds. Blades surround him and return when invisibility ends or he attacks/recasts.
Move Quick: Teemo scurries around, passively gaining bonus movement speed when not struck by enemies for a period. Teemo may also activate this ability to gain bonus movement speed for 3 seconds.
Recast - Deathly Leap: Thresh stops tugging his hook and dashes to the Shackled enemy, becoming able to attack again upon arrival. He can cast Dark Passage and Flay during the dash.

Active: Tristana jumps to the target location. Upon landing, she deals magic damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 40% for 2 seconds. Scoring an enemy champion takedown or detonating Explosive Charge at maximum stacks on a champion will reset Rocket Jump's cooldown.

Active: Trundle coats the target location in ice for 8 seconds. While he is within the area, he gains bonus attack speed, bonus movement speed, and 25% increased healing from all sources. [Bonus Movement Speed: 20/28/36/44/52%]
Tryndamere slices toward a target unit, dealing damage to enemies in his path.
Destiny: Twisted Fate reveals all enemy champions globally, then can activate Gate to blink to any revealed location after a short channel.

Active: After a 1-second delay, Twitch becomes camouflaged for a duration. During this time, Twitch gains 10% bonus movement speed, increased to 30% while facing enemy champions within a 1000-unit radius who cannot see him.

Active - Stance: Udyr enters Stampede Stance. Additionally, Udyr becomes ghosted and gains bonus movement speed for 4 seconds, which decays to 30% effectiveness over 1.5 seconds. Recast - Awaken: Udyr gains an additional 30% : 40% (based on level) bonus movement speed.
Disdain: Urgot charges forward 450 units, shielding himself and trampling non-champion enemies. He stops and hurls the first champion hit behind him, dealing damage.

Night Hunter (Passive): Vayne gains 30 bonus movement speed when moving toward a visible enemy champion. This bonus persists for 2 seconds after losing sight of the enemy. Triples to 90 during Final Hour.
Tumble: Vayne tumbles a short distance in the target direction and empowers her next basic attack.

Recast: Vex dashes towards the marked target with displacement immunity. Upon arrival, she consumes their mark and deals magic damage. If Vex scores a takedown against Shadow Surge's marked target within 6 seconds of its application, Vex can cast Shadow Surge again within 12 seconds at no cost after 0.5 seconds.

Active: Viego sends a spectre in the target direction that creates a trail of mist in its wake which lasts 8 seconds. While inside the mist, Viego gains bonus attack speed. If he does not attack or cast abilities, he also gains bonus movement speed and camouflage.
Heartbreaker: Viego abandons his current possession and teleports to the enemy champion with the lowest percent health in range, dealing bonus damage.

Recast: Viego hurls a blast of mist in the target direction and dashes a fixed distance in the same direction, though not through terrain. The mist deals magic damage to the first enemy hit and stuns them.
Augment: Turbocharge - After the device hits, Viktor gains 30% bonus movement speed for 2.5 seconds and the shield's strength is increased.
Vi charges her gauntlets and unleashes a vault shattering punch, carrying her forward. Enemies she hits are knocked back and receive a stack of Denting Blows.
Vi singles out an enemy champion, revealing them and dashing unstoppably towards them.
At 2 points of Crimson Rush, Vladimir surges, gaining 10% / 20% / 30% / 40% (based on level) bonus movement speed decaying over 0.5 seconds while the Crimson Rush depletes over 2.5 seconds.

Active: Vladimir sinks into a pool of blood, becoming untargetable and ghosted for 2 seconds. He also gains 37.5% bonus movement speed that decays exponentially over 1 second. Enemies within the pool are dealt magic damage every 0.5 seconds.
Thundering Smash: Volibear gains 12/15.5/19/22.5/26% Movement Speed, doubled toward enemy champions, for 4 seconds. Next attack deals bonus damage and stuns.

Stormbringer: Volibear transforms and leaps to a target location (700 range) with crowd control immunity, gaining Health and Attack Range for several seconds. Upon landing deals damage and slows enemies.
Warwick lunges at his target (range 365). If held, after the bite he channels 0.5 seconds then leaps behind the target, positioning at his attack range edge behind them.
Warwick leaps in a direction scaling with his bonus Move Speed (range = 250% of current movement speed, base ~837.5 at 335 MS), suppressing the first champion hit for 1.5 seconds.

Passive: Warwick senses enemies below 50% health, gaining 35 / 42.5 / 50 / 57.5 / 65% bonus movement speed toward them (tripled to 70-130% against enemies below 25% health). Active: marks nearest champion for 8 seconds.
Featherstorm: Xayah leaps into the air and becomes briefly untargetable, raining down a volley of feathers that damage and leave feather trails, then lands at roughly the same location.

Deadly Plumage: Xayah surrounds herself with a storm of feathers for 4 seconds, gaining bonus attack speed. Whenever she attacks a champion during this time, she gains 30% bonus movement speed for 1.5 seconds.

Active: Xin Zhao dashes to the target enemy's location, dealing magic damage to enemies near them and slowing them by 30% for 0.5 seconds. Audacious Charge's range is increased against Challenged targets. (normal range 650, Challenged range 1100)

Active: Yasuo dashes a fixed distance in the direction of the target enemy and becomes ghosted for 2 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts. Upon impact, he deals magic damage to the target and generates a stack of Ride the Wind for 5 seconds.

Active: Yasuo blinks to the opposite side of a visible airborne enemy champion nearest to the cursor, instantly generating maximum Flow while resetting Gathering Storm stacks. A nearby airborne enemy champion is required to cast this ability.

Active: Yone dashes a fixed distance in the target direction, including through terrain, discarding his body and entering Spirit Form for 5 seconds. Spirit Form grants 10% to 30% ramping bonus movement speed but the primary effect is the repositioning dash.
At 2 stacks, Mortal Steel dashes Yone forward with a gust of wind knocking enemies Airborne.
Yone strikes all enemies along a path, teleporting behind the last champion hit and Knocking Up victims towards Yone.

Active: Yunara dashes in the target direction. Untouchable Shadow resets Yunara's basic attack timer. Arc of Ruin can be cast during the dash. This ability benefits from ultimate ability effects and is the upgraded version of Kanmei's Steps during Transcendent State.

Active: Yuumi channels for 0.25 seconds, then upon completion dashes to the target allied champion and attaches to them upon arrival. Recast - Change of Plan: Yuumi detaches from her Anchor and dashes to the target allied champion to attach to them.

Elastic Slingshot: Zac pulls himself taut, charging up a dash in the target direction. Maximum range increases to 1200/1350/1500/1650/1800 based on rank. Upon recast he launches to the target location, knocking up enemies on landing.
Let's Bounce!: Zac bounces 4 times over 3 seconds, gaining up to 20%-50% (based on duration elapsed) bonus Movement Speed while bouncing.
Zed becomes untargetable and after a 0.6s delay dashes 125 units beyond the target (range 625). Recast: Zed and the shadow blink to swap places, returning to the original cast location.
Zed's shadow dashes forward up to 650 units, remaining for 5 seconds. Recast: Zed and the Shadow blink to swap places.
Spark Surge: Zeri dashes a short distance in the target direction, briefly overcharging her abilities. Spark Surge will vault over terrain if the dash is aimed toward it.
Living Battery (Passive): Whenever Zeri receives a shield, she gains 10% bonus movement speed for 3 seconds.

Lightning Crash: Zeri discharges a nova of electricity, damaging and slowing nearby enemies. She overcharges, gaining bonus movement speed, attack speed, and evolving her basic attacks for the duration.

Recast: Ziggs detonates the charge, causing it to explode to deal magic damage to nearby enemies and knock them back... If this hits Ziggs, he will dash up to 825 units away from the center of the explosion. Ziggs does not dash if he is immobilized or grounded.

Active: Zilean applies Time Warp to the target champion which lasts for 2.5 seconds. Time Warp: If the target is an ally, they gain bonus movement speed. (max rank 99% bonus MS for 2.5 seconds when self-targeted)

Active: After a 0.15-second delay, Zoe blinks in the target direction and remains there for 0.95 seconds to 1.25 seconds, during which she sets her movement speed to a static 0 and has unobstructed vision. Afterwards, she blinks back to her casting position.

Passive - Wheeeee: Whenever Zoe casts Spell Thief or a summoner spell, she gains bonus movement speed for a duration, and summons three bolts that orbit her for the next 10 seconds. [Bonus Movement Speed: 30/40/50/60/70%, Duration: 2/2.25/2.5/2.75/3 seconds]
